decisions.reason: Confirmation that the requested revision targets web-page content does not change the separate requirement to add missing image ALT attributes.
The web-page content clarification does not alter the requested coverage or scope of the on-page SEO progress report.
The source concerns web-page content revision and does not change the off-page backlink quantity, delivery window, or link-type percentages.
Clarifying that feedback concerns web-page content does not revise the selected campaign keywords, keyword count, or page mapping.
The source does not mention blog internal links or change their destinations, applicability, or publication condition.
The clarification identifies web-page content as the revision target and does not change the approved blog keyword list.
The source does not change blog production, article count, delivery timing, or publication conditions.
The web-page content clarification does not alter the requirement for relevant images or the specified image count in blog articles.
Although an updated blog-topics message precedes the exchange, the client explicitly confirms that the current discussion concerns web-page content, so no blog-topic state changes.
The source does not address or change the requirement to include search-volume metrics in the keyword research sheet.
